_comment: The default fleet (1 bootstrap, 3 delivery-module members) plus a
logos-delivery-demo UI that is not on the schedule: bring the fleet up, then
attach the demo by hand whenever you like, and take it down again.
./harness.sh start demo      # noVNC URL printed; stop demo to detach
LOGOSCORE_CLI_* for the dependencies this module otherwise chooses.
A branch is not a pin: out/resolved.json records the commit it resolved to.
Only what the chosen module ref cannot supply, or what we deliberately
differ on. master pins libp2p_module, openmetrics-module and
logos-delivery in its flake lock, so those are derived.
logos-logoscore-cli is not the module's own input: its lock only carries
copies pulled in by other inputs (libp2p_module, logos-test-modules), and
its docker-compose runs yet another. The harness keeps running 665ac28b,
the version every recorded run used. `harness.sh resolve` shows each source.
